sourcePolicy: Nur Rebrickable Catalog Downloads/CSV, keine MOC-Dateien.
methodology: A selection is allowed only when the Rebrickable catalog name or the official LDraw redirect/description distinguishes one candidate without guessing. Entries that collapse colour, mould or pose variants remain blocked.

selections.catalogName: Minifig Head Uruk-hai, Scowling / Handprint Print
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Head with LOTR Uruk-Hai Scowl and White Hand 2-Sided Pattern (Hollow Stud)
selections.reason: The catalog number specifies the 3626c hollow-stud mould; the other candidate is the pierced-base 3626b mould.

selections.catalogName: Minifig Head, Glasses with Brown Thin Eyebrows, Smile Print
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Head with Glasses, Thin Brown Eyebrows, Smile Pattern (Hollow Stud)
selections.reason: Only this official description contains the catalog's thin-eyebrow feature; the other file describes rounded glasses.

selections.catalogName: Headwear Accessory Visor Grille with Top Pin Hole (Castle)
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Helmet Visor Pointed with Squared Nose
selections.reason: The exact official 2594.dat file is a ~Moved to redirect to 2594b.dat.

selections.catalogName: Bald Head with Tied Red Bandana Print
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Headdress Bald Head with Tied Red Bandana Pattern
selections.reason: This description matches a bald head with a red bandana; the other candidate describes a red bald head.

selections.catalogName: Torso Hoodie, Open over Dark Red Undeshirt Print, Light Bluish Gray Arms, Light Nougat Hands
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Torso with Arms and Light Nougat Hands with  Hooded Sweatshirt Open with Drawstrings over Dark Red Top Pattern

selections.officialDescription: Minifig Torso with Arms and Black Hands with SW Dark Red Robe Pattern

selections.catalogName: Torso Tunic with Tied Lace and Purse Print (Forestman), Blue Arms, Yellow Hands
selections.officialDescription: Minifig Torso with Blue Arms and Hands with Forestman and Purse Pattern
selections.reason: The selected shortcut fixes Blue arms and Yellow hands exactly as named by the catalog.
